stories.headline: Ant Group’s Robbyant open-sources tactile AI model for robot hands
stories.script: In China. Ant Group’s robotics unit Robbyant has released model weights and inference code for LingBot-Touch, a model designed to help robot hands use touch to handle objects. It was trained on nearly 5,000 hours of recordings from three types of tactile sensors so that it could work across different hardware. Robbyant evaluated the model on 26 real-world tasks using two robotic hands. The tests included handling fragile objects and coordinating both hands.

stories.headline: Teenager who planned terror attack in Sydney tells court he was radicalised online and used AI to strategise
stories.script: Around the world. Boy says he was first exposed to extremist material on TikTok, turned to Telegram and YouTube for bomb-making instructions, and used ChatGPT to devise his plans Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A teenager who admitted to planning a terrorist attack in Sydney in 2024 has told the court he was radicalised online after first seeing extremist material on TikTok and used ChatGPT to form his plans. The 16-year-old, known under the pseudonym as RK due to his age, pleaded guilty to acts in preparation for, or planning, a terrorist act. In a sentencing ruling on Monday, he avoided jail time, with the New South Wales supreme court ordering him into a three-year community corrections order.
